tool_description: DermLipDDX performs large-scale differential diagnosis for clinical skin images. Trained on the Derm1M with knowledge-enhanced vision–language pre-training (MAKE), it can return a single best diagnosis, the top-3, or the top-5 ranked skin-condition labels—covering hundreds of diseases.

image_path.description: Absolute path to a clinical skin image (PNG/JPG).

top3ddx.description: If true, returns the top-3 ranked differential diagnoses.

top5ddx.description: If true, returns the top-5 ranked differential diagnoses.

predictions_stdout.description: Console (stdout) output listing the predicted label(s) with confidence scores.

txt_format.description:
• Single prediction: one line '<disease>: <probability>'
• Top-N: N lines '<rank>. <disease>: <probability>'
